assessment.nobel_worthiness: Exact fluctuation and work relations give simple statistical structure to nonequilibrium processes, a foundational advance in understanding irreversibility.
assessment.attribution: Evans represents early fluctuation relations, Jarzynski the work equality, Crooks the forward/reverse work relation.
assessment.maturity: The mathematical relations are mature and have substantial numerical and experimental support under defined assumptions.
uncertainties: The packet lacks the full contribution history and experimental conditions. Generality should not be claimed outside the relations' assumptions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Conformal symmetry exposed universal structure in two-dimensional critical phenomena and enabled exact results across otherwise complicated fluctuating systems.
assessment.attribution: The supplied trio represents the foundational joint conformal-field-theory construction.
assessment.maturity: The mathematical framework and critical-model predictions are mature and extensively tested.
uncertainties: The packet does not delimit the common breakthrough from later individual contributions or specify which experimental systems satisfy its assumptions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamical mean-field theory supplied a clean, productive mechanism for treating electronic correlations and connecting models to material measurements.
assessment.attribution: Georges and Kotliar represent dynamical self-consistency, Vollhardt the infinite-dimensional foundation.
assessment.maturity: The framework has a long record of numerical development and comparison with experiments.
uncertainties: Complete collaborator priority is absent, and exact limiting theory must be distinguished from approximate real-material applications.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Defect unbinding and hexatic order explain two-dimensional melting through a precise collective mechanism with universal implications.
assessment.attribution: The supplied trio represents development of the dislocation/disclination theory and predicted melting sequence.
assessment.maturity: The theory has sustained numerical and experimental support in appropriate interaction regimes.
uncertainties: The packet does not identify continuous versus first-order cases or distinguish the achievement from earlier recognized topological-transition foundations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Global quantum-phase structure provides a general explanation of observable interference and transport beyond a local-force picture.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov represents the electromagnetic phase effect, Berry adiabatic geometric phases. Their distinct discoveries are closely connected.
assessment.maturity: Both have mature theoretical and extensive independent experimental foundations.
uncertainties: The compound scope requires a precise citation and possibly divided recognition. The packet does not establish all original attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Electronic topology revealed robust structure in insulating states and connected classification to an observable boundary-conduction mechanism.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele represent prediction and classification, Molenkamp quantum-spin-Hall realization.
assessment.maturity: The central time-reversal-invariant phase is established and scientifically durable.
uncertainties: Hasan is also credited. A broader three-dimensional realization citation could change allocation; the packet lacks full priority documents.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Constrained frustrated magnets make emergent fractional excitations experimentally meaningful, an elegant mechanism connecting simple local rules to collective behavior.
assessment.attribution: Moessner and Sondhi plausibly represent the emergent-charge theory; Bramwell experimental spin-ice and excitation investigations.
assessment.maturity: The basic constrained-spin phenomenology is mature with substantial theoretical and experimental development.
uncertainties: The packet bundles spin-ice discovery with emergent-monopole interpretation and does not establish complete first-contribution credit. These excitations must not be described as elementary magnetic monopoles.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Energy landscapes gave biological folding an intelligible statistical account based on frustration and collective organization, with influential cross-disciplinary reach.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes and Onuchic represent landscape theory, Dill complementary folding models. The attribution is plausible but broad.
assessment.maturity: The framework has sustained use in theory, simulations and experimental interpretation.
uncertainties: The packet lacks decisive quantitative tests against competing mechanisms and a single sharp discovery definition; model universality does not settle each protein's dynamics.
